Child gates duplicate Show Modified, OK, Close and Quit; normal child close ends sheet, forced owner close invalidates and closes child.
Distinct options and progress NSWindows; options hides on OK, Merge Retry retires progress/reopens options, Mixed/Hard Retry keeps progress; final progress close retires owner.
